frame_time: t = frame / 24.007839 ; frame = round(t * 24.007839); last frame 48 at t = 1.99935 s
pixel_coords: x right, y down, origin top-left of the 1080x1080 frame
view: Top-down (bird's-eye) perspective render of a living room. Floor is roughly perpendicular to the optical axis; walls lean outward at the image edges (perspective), so tall objects' tops are slightly enlarged/displaced relative to floor-level objects.

camera.evidence: frame differencing over all 49 frames: only the robot vacuum region changes (plus a 1-3 frame flicker of ~50 px at x~152-167, y~777-790 at the TV corner, compression noise). Background shift = 0 px every frame.

robot_vacuum.description: white round disc-shaped robot vacuum on the floor/rug edge, bottom-left of the rug at start; the only moving object
robot_vacuum.reference_point: centre of the fitted circle of the top disc (= object origin in top view)
robot_vacuum.visible_frames: 0-48 (fully visible 0-32; progressively occluded by the sofa's lower-left arm from frame 33; frames 42-48 only a ~15 px tall sliver below the sofa is visible, centre from fixed-radius circle fit of that arc)
robot_vacuum.diameter_px_note: median fitted circle diameter over 33 unoccluded frames, sd 0.33 px (radius 34.39 px); visible bbox ~70x70 px
robot_vacuum.motion: straight horizontal line to the right (+x) at constant image row y = 811.5 +/- 0.3 px; centre x 353.4 (f0) -> 757.2 (f48); mean step 8.41 px/frame, per-frame steps 7.75-9.25 px (fit noise), no visible acceleration
robot_vacuum.path_length_px_f0_f48: 403.9 (sum of per-frame steps; motion is straight)

events.event: vacuum already moving right at video start (step f0->f1 = 8.6 px); no start of motion seen
vacuum's right edge reaches the sofa's lower-left arm (x~666) and starts passing under it
vacuum centre passes under sofa bottom edge region; from frame 42 only the bottom sliver (y 832-846) is visible
video ends; vacuum still moving right under the sofa, no stop/bounce/direction change observed
